say:2:1041565901:1.text: Now that Seralyth's tyranny has ended. May the next ruler govern with a lighter hand.
say:2:1041565901:1.source_cn: 奈萨雷斯的残暴统治结束了，接下来的管理应当更温和一些。

say:3:1041565902:1.text: In order to avoid the recurrence of past tragedies maybe...
say:3:1041565902:1.source_cn: 为了避免昔日的惨剧重演……

say:4:1041565903:1.text: I think you are on the wrong track, my friend.
say:4:1041565903:1.source_cn: 朋友，我想你走上了歧途。

say:5:1041565904:1.text: What do you think can cover the wounds of the past?
say:5:1041565904:1.source_cn: 你认为，用什么才能覆盖惩戒的痛楚呢？

say:7:1041565906:1.text: No, my dear friend, it's quite the opposite.
say:7:1041565906:1.source_cn: 不，亲爱的朋友，恰好相反。

say:8:1041565907:1.text: The only way to cover up the pain is to inflict even more pain.
say:8:1041565907:1.source_cn: 想要覆盖痛楚，唯有给予更强的痛楚。

say:9:1041565908:1.text: You said the past tragedies of your people corrupted their path, yes? Then purify them with fire and steel. Only through harsher trials can they be redeemed.
say:9:1041565908:1.source_cn: 倘若如你所说，此前的惨剧已经走上歧途，那么正道就必须更...

say:10:1041565909:1.text: That's... some logic you've got there.

say:11:1041565910:1.text: Discipline and punishment seem counter-intuitive only to those who've never ruled. Commoners will never understand the necessity, my naive friend.
say:11:1041565910:1.source_cn: 惩罚、戒律，这一切原本就是反直觉——或者说是平民的直觉...

say:12:1041565911:1.text: Never forget. Everything is a reward in its own way.
say:12:1041565911:1.source_cn: 记住，你所给予的一切，都是“奖赏”，无论鞭子还是糖果。

say:13:1041565912:1.text: A sharper whip today makes tomorrow's candy taste all the sweeter.
say:13:1041565912:1.source_cn: 鞭子越严厉，糖果才会越甜美。

say:14:1041565913:1.text: Only then will the people follow your rules without question, like sheep in a pen.
say:14:1041565913:1.source_cn: 唯有如此，民众们才能在你的纪律下，服从如乖顺的羔羊。

say:15:1041565914:1.text: But why stop at sheep? Break them properly, and they'll become well-trained hounds at your beck and call.
say:15:1041565914:1.source_cn: 若是尚有兴趣，还可以驯养些乖巧的猎犬。

say:16:1041565915:1.text: The process might take some effort, but I promise the results will be more than worth it.
say:16:1041565915:1.source_cn: 相信我，过程或许有些麻烦，但结果一定会令你满意。

say:17:1041565916:1.text: But should a hound turn its fangs on you...I bet that would definitely be unpleasant... for you.
say:17:1041565916:1.source_cn: 如果狗反咬一口，恐怕滋味不太美妙吧。

say:19:1041565918:1.text: I hoped the weight we both carried would mean we understood each other. But maybe I expected too much.
say:19:1041565918:1.source_cn: 我原本以为我们的职责相同，会很有共同语言呢。

say:20:1041565919:1.text: Unlike some of my noble friends, I judge no one by their birth or station.
say:20:1041565919:1.source_cn: 我与我一些有着相同嗜好的高贵友人们不同，对出身并无特别...

say:21:1041565920:1.text: However, now I have to admit that commoners will always have their weaknesses.
say:21:1041565920:1.source_cn: 但，此时我也不得不承认。平民总归是有平民的软弱之处。

say:22:1041565921:1.text: It is unfortunate. I've come this far precisely to tear down these "noble values" that people like you use to justify oppression.
say:22:1041565921:1.source_cn: 不巧，我也正是为了粉碎所谓“贵族的残酷”，才一路走到此处的。

say:23:1041565922:1.text: Although I've committed similar evil deeds as you, I will always be a hound in your eyes.
say:23:1041565922:1.source_cn: 就算我曾经做过与你相似的恶行，但幸运或者不幸的是，我始...

say:24:1041565923:1.text: But I've never regretted turning my back to bite the throats of the noble masters of the world.
say:24:1041565923:1.source_cn: 所以，至今为止，我也从未后悔过，回头咬烂那些尊贵“主人...
